title: 上部 凡尘问道 第9章 三日夜引气破常识上部 凡尘问道 第10章 筛选赛杂役胜外门
content_zh:
第1节无灵根困境，功法送希望
杂役营的简陋木屋中，烛火摇曳，映照着凌无妄凝重的脸庞。距离外门筛选赛仅剩三日，而他面临着一个几乎不可能完成的任务——引气入体。
道院三千年来，从未有过无灵根者引气成功的先例。灵根如同灵气与人体连接的桥梁，没有灵根，灵气便无法在经脉中停留，更别说凝聚成灵力。
“无妄哥，这真的能做到吗？”凌小雨攥着衣角，眼中满是担忧。她从其他杂役口中得知，就算是天赋最差的伪灵根，引气入体也至少需要半月，而凌无妄只有三天。
凌母也叹了口气“无妄，实在不行就放弃吧，我们再想别的办法，总比去送死好。”
凌无妄没有说话，只是看着手中的功法卷轴——这是苏晚晴刚刚送来的《青萍诀》，一部低阶引气功法，虽然品阶不高，但胜在基础扎实，是外门弟子常用的入门功法。
“伯母，小雨，我不能放弃。”凌无妄语气坚定，“如果不能通过筛选赛，王坤和赵虎绝不会善罢甘休，我们在杂役营也永无宁日。”
就在这时，木屋门被推开，苏晚晴走了进来，脸上带着一丝疲惫“这是我能找到的最适合入门的功法，虽然品阶不高，但修炼难度最低。”
她将一个瓷瓶放在桌上“这里面是三枚聚气丹，能辅助凝聚灵气，希望能帮到你。”
“谢谢你，晚晴。”凌无妄拿起《青萍诀》，指尖刚触碰到卷轴，系统面板便弹出提示
【检测到低阶引气功法《青萍诀》，解析中……解析完成】
【功法缺陷经脉传导路径冗余（共17处不必要折返），灵气转化率仅31%，需消耗大量时间磨合灵根与灵气的适配性】
【核心问题无灵根者无法建立灵气滞留机制，常规修炼100%失败】
凌无妄心中一沉，果然，常规功法对无灵根者根本无效。《青萍诀》的修炼逻辑是通过灵根引导灵气在十二正经循环三周后汇入丹田，而他没有灵根，灵气进入体内后只会瞬间逸散。
“无灵根者真的无法引气吗？”苏晚晴看着他，眼中满是担忧，“我曾在**中看到过记载，说灵气是天地本源能量，理论上任何人都能吸收，只是需要特定的引导方式。”
“特定的引导方式……”凌无妄喃喃自语，运转规则之眼，再次看向《青萍诀》。
卷轴上的功法符文在他眼中清晰展开，灵气流动的路径如同一条条发光的丝线，错综复杂。他突然意识到，功法之所以需要灵根，是因为灵根能提供一个“锚点”，让灵气在经脉中停留。
而他没有灵根，是否可以跳过灵根这个环节，直接让灵气在丹田形成循环？
“也许，我可以修改功法。”凌无妄眼中闪过一丝精光。
“修改功法？”苏晚晴大惊失色，“道院功法都是经过无数先辈验证的，擅自修改极易导致经脉错乱，甚至走火入魔！”

“常规功法不适合我，只能冒险一试。”凌无妄没有退缩，“时间紧迫，我必须在三日内找到引气入体的方法。”
屋外传来杂役的议论声，夹杂着嘲笑“无灵根还“无灵根还想引气入体？简直是白日做梦！”
“我看他是怕了王监工的侄子，故意装模作样，想拖延时间吧？”
“三天后筛选赛，有他好受的，王浩师兄肯定会废了他！”
这些话如同针一般刺在凌母和凌小雨心上，但凌无妄却不为所动。他知道，只有用实力打破质疑，才能在道院立足。
第2节规则破局，极简引气法
凌无妄盘膝坐下，将《青萍诀》放在膝上，运转规则之眼，开始逐字逐句解析功法。
《青萍诀》的核心是“引气、导气、凝气”三步引天地灵气入体，通过十二正经导入丹田，再凝聚成灵力。但这三步对无灵根者来说，每一步都充满阻碍。
“引气阶段，灵气无法停留，是因为没有灵根作为锚点。”凌无妄思索道，“那我就直接跳过经脉引导，让灵气从毛孔直接进入丹田。”
“导气阶段，十二正经的路径太过冗余，灵气在传导过程中浪费严重。”他用手指在地上画出经脉图，“可以剔除手臂和腿部的九条冗余经脉，只保留&nbp;tr部位的三条核心经脉，缩短灵气流动路径。”
“凝气阶段，常规功法需要灵气在丹田盘旋九周才能凝聚，我可以让灵气形成一个微型漩涡，通过旋转产生的离心力，让灵气自行凝聚。”
content_en:
Section 1: Dilemma of No Spiritual Root, Kung Fu Gives Hope
In the simple wooden house in the handyman camp, the candlelight flickered, reflecting Ling Wuwang's solemn face. There were only three days left before the outer gate screening competition, and he faced an almost impossible task - to introduce air into the body.
In the three thousand years of Taoism, there has never been a precedent for a person without spiritual roots to successfully channel Qi. Spiritual roots are like the bridge connecting spiritual energy to the human body. Without spiritual roots, spiritual energy cannot stay in the meridians, let alone condense into spiritual power.
"Brother Wuwang, can this really be done?" Ling Xiaoyu clenched the corners of her clothes, her eyes full of worry. She learned from other handymen that even the least talented pseudo-spiritual root would take at least half a month to draw Qi into the body, while Ling Wuwang only had three days.
Ling's mother also sighed, "Wuwang, if it doesn't work, just give up. It's better for us to think of other ways than to die."
Ling Wuwang didn't speak, just looked at the skill scroll in his hand - this was "Qingping Jue" that Su Wanqing had just sent, a low-level Qi-entraining skill. Although the grade was not high, it had a solid foundation. It was a commonly used introductory skill for outer disciples.
"Aunt, Xiaoyu, I can't give up." Ling Wuwang said firmly, "If we can't pass the screening, Wang Kun and Zhao Hu will never give up, and we will never have peace in the handyman camp."
At this moment, the door of the wooden house was pushed open, and Su Wanqing walked in with a trace of exhaustion on her face. "This is the most suitable method for beginners that I can find. Although the level is not high, it is the least difficult to practice."
She placed a porcelain bottle on the table, "There are three Qi Gathering Pills in it, which can help condense spiritual energy. I hope they can help you."
"Thank you, Wan Qing." Ling Wuwang picked up "Qingping Jue" and as soon as his fingertips touched the scroll, a prompt popped up on the system panel
[The low-level Qi-entraining technique "Qing Ping Jue" has been detected, analyzing... analysis completed]
[The deficiencies in the exercise are redundant meridian conduction paths (a total of 17 unnecessary turns), the spiritual energy conversion rate is only 31%, and it takes a lot of time to adjust the adaptability of spiritual roots and spiritual energy]
[The core problem is that those without spiritual roots cannot establish the spiritual energy retention mechanism, and regular practice will fail 100%]
Ling Wuwang's heart sank. Sure enough, conventional exercises were ineffective against those without spiritual roots. The training logic of "Qing Ping Jue" is to guide the spiritual energy through the spiritual roots to flow into the Dantian after three weeks of the twelve main meridians. However, since he has no spiritual roots, the spiritual energy will only escape instantly after entering the body.
"Is it true that those without spiritual roots cannot draw Qi?" Su Wanqing looked at him, her eyes full of worry, "I have seen records in newspapers, saying that spiritual energy is the original energy of heaven and earth. In theory, anyone can absorb it, but it requires a specific guidance method."
"Specific guidance method..." Ling Wuwang murmured to himself, running the eyes of rules, and looked at "Qingping Jue" again.
The skill runes on the scroll unfolded clearly in his eyes, and the path of the spiritual energy flowing was like luminous threads, intricate. He suddenly realized that the reason why the martial arts required spiritual roots was because the spiritual roots could provide an "anchor point" for spiritual energy to stay in the meridians.
And since he has no spiritual roots, can he skip the spiritual root step and directly let the spiritual energy circulate in his Dantian?
"Perhaps, I can modify the technique." A glint flashed in Ling Wuwang's eyes.
"Modify the exercises?" Su Wanqing was shocked. "The Taoist exercises have been verified by countless predecessors. Modifications without authorization can easily cause meridians to become disordered, or even go crazy!"
"Conventional exercises are not suitable for me, so I can only take a risk." Ling Wuwang did not flinch, "Time is tight, I must find a way to introduce Qi into the body within three days."
The chatter of the handymen came from outside the house, mixed with ridicule: "You don't have spiritual roots?" "You don't have spiritual roots and you want to introduce Qi into your body?" What a daydream! "
"I think he is afraid of Supervisor Wang's nephew and is deliberately pretending to delay time, right? "
"Three days later in the screening competition, if he has an easy time, Senior Brother Wang Hao will definitely destroy him! "
These words were like needles piercing Ling's mother and Ling's mother.Xiaoyu was concerned, but Ling Wuwang was unmoved. He knew that only by using strength to overcome doubts could he gain a foothold in the Taoist Academy.
Section 2 Rules Breaking the Game, Minimalist Air Entrainment Method
Ling Wuwang sat down cross-legged, put "Qing Ping Jue" on his lap, turned his eyes of rules, and began to analyze the technique word by word.
The core of "Qing Ping Jue" is the three steps of "introducing Qi, guiding Qi, and condensing Qi" to introduce the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into the body, guide it into the Dantian through the twelve meridians, and then condense it into spiritual power. But for those without spiritual roots, each of these three steps is full of obstacles.
"In the Qi-entraining stage, the spiritual energy cannot stay because there are no spiritual roots as anchors." Ling Wuwang thought, "Then I will just skip the meridians and let the spiritual energy enter the Dantian directly from the pores."
"In the Qi conduction stage, the paths of the twelve main meridians are too redundant, and the spiritual energy is wasted during the conduction process." He drew a meridian diagram on the ground with his fingers. "The nine redundant meridians in the arms and legs can be eliminated, and only the three core meridians in the tr area can be retained, shortening the spiritual energy flow path."
"In the Qi condensation stage, conventional exercises require the spiritual energy to circle around the Dantian for nine times to condense. I can make the spiritual energy form a micro vortex, and let the spiritual energy condense on its own through the centrifugal force generated by the rotation."
